recognize_zh: 淡綠色背景下，左上角有一大團密集、深染、大小一致的小圓形至橢圓形菌體聚集（推測原本位於組織球內），周圍也散在少數單顆菌體；GMS 銀染讓小酵母菌凸顯，支持組織漿菌感染。
features: Dense cluster of numerous uniform, small round-to-oval dark-staining organisms (upper left), consistent with a yeast-laden histiocyte
Scattered single dark yeast forms throughout the smear
Light green counterstained background with red cell ghosts; host cell outlines are not well defined
Budding and precise size cannot be resolved at this low magnification; the organisms appear dark violet rather than jet black in this image
describe_en: GMS-stained bone marrow aspirate smear viewed at low power shows a light green background with red cell ghosts. A dense aggregate of numerous small, uniform, round-to-oval silver-positive organisms is present in the upper left field, in keeping with a yeast-laden histiocyte, and scattered single organisms are seen elsewhere. Budding forms and exact size cannot be resolved at this magnification. Findings are consistent with disseminated small-yeast infection of the marrow, supporting Histoplasma capsulatum in the appropriate clinical and culture context.

ddx.vs: Leishmania amastigotes are GMS-negative and show a kinetoplast on Giemsa, whereas Histoplasma yeasts are silver-positive.
Also GMS-positive small yeast, but shows elongated forms with a central transverse septum rather than narrow-based budding.
Cryptococcus is larger and more variable (4-10 um) with a thick mucicarmine-positive capsule.
Pneumocystis cysts are cup-shaped and extracellular, and Candida glabrata is slightly larger with less uniform intracellular packing; culture or antigen testing resolves ambiguity.
